chinese_meaning: 計劃好的;算計好的;蓄意的
example_en: It was a cruel, calculated crime with absolutely no justification.
example_zh: 這是一樁兇殘的、蓄意策劃的罪行，毫無正當理由。

example_en: I remember my carefree student days.
example_zh: 我還記得我那無憂無慮的學生時代。

chinese_meaning: （輪船、飛機等大型交通工具裝載的）貨物
example_en: a cargo ship/plane
example_zh: 貨船／貨運飛機

example_en: a horse-drawn carriage
example_zh: 四輪馬車

example_en: This totem pole is carved from/out of a single tree trunk.
example_zh: 這根圖騰柱是由一整根樹幹雕刻而成的。

chinese_meaning: （嚴重事故或戰爭中的）傷亡人員
example_en: The rebels suffered heavy casualties.
example_zh: 叛亂分子傷亡慘重。

example_en: They were warned of the ecological catastrophe to come.
example_zh: 他們收到警告，生態災難即將來臨。

example_en: The college/hospital/prison has its own chapel.
example_zh: 學院／醫院／監獄有自己的小教堂。

chinese_meaning: （尤指疾病或不好的事物）慢性的，長期的
example_en: chronic diseases/conditions
example_zh: 慢性病

example_en: They first met each other on the tennis circuit (= while at different tennis competitions).
example_zh: 他們在網球巡迴賽上首次交鋒。

example_en: The bomb killed four soldiers and three civilians.
example_zh: 炸彈炸死四名士兵及三名平民。

example_en: There has been a call for greater clarity in this area of the law.
example_zh: 人們呼籲該法規的這個方面應該更加明確一些。

chinese_meaning: 打鬥，打架;發生衝突;爭論，爭辯
example_en: Students clashed with police after demonstrations at five universities.
example_zh: 學生在五所大學示威之後與員警發生了衝突。

example_en: Does she study classical ballet or modern ballet?
example_zh: 她學的是古典芭蕾還是現代芭蕾？

example_en: Do you understand the system of classification used in ornithology?
example_zh: 你懂鳥類學的分類體系嗎？

example_en: We got so wet that our clothes clung to us.
example_zh: 我們濕透了，衣服緊緊地貼在身上。

example_en: factory/branch closures
example_zh: 工廠／分店的關閉

chinese_meaning: （通常指因恐懼、焦慮或痛苦而）緊抓，緊握
example_en: Silent and pale, she clutched (onto) her mother's hand.
example_zh: 她一聲不吭，面色蒼白，死死抓著母親的手。

example_en: I timed my holiday to coincide with the children's.
example_zh: 我把我的假期安排在孩子學校放假的時候。

example_en: There was fierce combat between the two sides.
example_zh: 雙方展開了激烈的戰鬥。

example_en: Commander Phillips/James Phillips
example_zh: 菲利普斯海軍中校／詹姆斯·菲利普斯

chinese_meaning: （尤指舉行公開儀式或豎立雕塑或特別建築）紀念，緬懷
example_en: Gathered all together in this church, we commemorate those who lost their lives in the war.
example_zh: 我們聚集在這座教堂裡，緬懷那些在大戰中喪生的人。

example_en: We will commence building work in August of next year.
example_zh: 我們將於明年八月開始破土動工。

example_en: a dark/fair complexion
example_zh: 黝黑／白皙的膚色

example_en: a problem of great complexity
example_zh: 極複雜的難題

example_en: He complained that his husband never paid him any compliments anymore.
example_zh: 她抱怨說丈夫再也不讚美她了。

example_en: The listening device was concealed in a pen.
example_zh: 竊聽裝置藏在筆裡。

example_en: The government has conceded (that) the new tax policy has been a disaster.
example_zh: 政府承認新的稅收政策是徹底失敗的。

chinese_meaning: 自負的，自大的，自以為是的
example_en: Without wishing to sound conceited, I am the best salesperson in the company.
example_zh: 不是我自誇，我是公司最好的推銷員。

example_en: I think my uncle still conceives of me as a four-year-old.
example_zh: 我覺得我叔叔仍然把我看成是四歲的小孩。

example_en: People from different cultures have different conceptions of the world.
example_zh: 不同文化背景的人對世界持有不同的看法。

chinese_meaning: （常指為結束爭端而作出的）認可，讓步，妥協
example_en: Both sides involved in the conflict made some concessions in yesterday's talks.
example_zh: 在昨天的談判中，衝突雙方都作出了讓步。

example_en: Be careful not to introduce new ideas in the conclusion of your essay.
example_zh: 注意不要在你的論文結論部分引入新的想法。

chinese_meaning: （通常指出於道義而）譴責，指責
example_en: The terrorist action has been condemned as an act of barbarism and cowardice.
example_zh: 人們譴責這一恐怖行徑是野蠻和懦弱的行爲。

chinese_meaning: 面對，面臨；遭遇；直面，正視
example_en: As she left the court, she was confronted by angry crowds who tried to block her way.
example_zh: 她離開法庭時，憤怒的人群試圖攔住她的去路。

example_en: Some couples seem to like confrontation, but Josh and I hardly ever argue.
example_zh: 有的夫妻似乎很喜歡爭吵，我跟喬許卻幾乎沒有吵過嘴。

example_en: a guilty conscience
example_zh: 問心有愧

chinese_meaning: 連續的，連貫的，無間斷的
example_en: This is the fifth consecutive weekend that I've spent working.
example_zh: 這是我連續第五個週末加班。

example_en: The general consensus in the office is that he can't do his job.
example_zh: 辦公室成員一致認爲他無法勝任工作。

chinese_meaning: 一貫的；堅持的；始終如一的
example_en: There has been a consistent improvement in her attitude.
example_zh: 她的態度一直在改進。

chinese_meaning: 憲法（或章程）允許的，符合憲法（或章程）的
example_en: Such a policy would not be constitutional.
example_zh: 這樣的政策是不符合憲法的。

example_en: The country's progress was constrained by a leader who refused to look forward.
example_zh: 國家領導人缺乏發展眼光限制了該國的進步。

example_en: The constraints of politeness wouldn't allow her to say what she really thought about his cooking.
example_zh: 出於禮貌，她不會說出自己對他的廚藝的真實看法。

example_en: After consultations with our accountants, we've decided how to cut costs within the company.
example_zh: 與會計師商討後，我們確定了如何削減公司內部的開支。

example_en: I usually wear contact lenses, but I sometimes wear glasses when my eyes are tired.
example_zh: 我通常戴隱形眼鏡，但有時眼睛疲勞時會戴框架眼鏡。

example_en: I'm contemplating going abroad for a year.
example_zh: 我打算出國一年。

example_en: At school she had complete contempt for all her teachers.
example_zh: 在學校讀書時她對所有老師都不屑一顧。

chinese_meaning: 大洲的，大陸的;大陸性的，似大陸的
example_en: Geologists map past and future continental drift.
example_zh: 地質學家繪製過去和未來的大陸漂移圖。

example_en: There has been no continuity in that class - they've had six different teachers.
example_zh: 那門課上得沒有連貫性——前後一共有六名老師教。

example_en: You say that you're good friends and yet you don't trust him. Isn't that a contradiction?
example_zh: 你說你們是好朋友，可你又不信任他。那不是有點矛盾嗎？

chinese_meaning: 對立的;相互矛盾的;不一致的
example_en: I keep getting contradictory advice - some people tell me to keep it warm and some tell me to put ice on it.
example_zh: 我不斷得到相互矛盾的建議——有人要我保暖，有人叫我敷冰。

example_en: Solar power is the conversion of the sun's energy into heat and electricity.
example_zh: 太陽能動力是將太陽能轉化為熱和電。

chinese_meaning: （在法庭上）宣判…有罪，證明…有罪
example_en: He has twice been convicted of robbery/arson.
example_zh: 他兩次被判犯有搶劫罪／縱火罪。

example_en: Since it was her first conviction for stealing, she was given a less severe sentence.
example_zh: 由於她是初次犯盜竊罪，對她的量刑不是很重。

example_en: a coral bracelet/necklace
example_zh: 珊瑚手鐲／項鏈

chinese_meaning: 核心，關鍵，最重要的部分
example_en: The lack of government funding is at the core of the problem.
example_zh: 缺乏政府撥款是問題的關鍵所在。

example_en: Although she often disagreed with me, she was always courteous.
example_zh: 儘管她常常和我意見不一致，卻總是客氣有禮。

example_en: There has been a series of government crackdowns on safety in factories.
example_zh: 針對工廠安全問題，政府有一系列的處罰措施。

example_en: His arrest for lewd behaviour seriously damaged his credibility as a religious leader.
example_zh: 他因猥褻行為被捕，這嚴重地損害了他作爲宗教領袖的信譽。

chinese_meaning: （通常指爲避免注意而）緩慢行進，悄悄移動，潛行
example_en: She turned off the light and crept through the door.
example_zh: 她關上燈，悄悄溜出門。

chinese_meaning: 粗糙的；簡陋的；粗製的；未加修飾的
example_en: a crude device/weapon
example_zh: 簡陋的裝置／粗製的武器

example_en: She nervously crumbled the bread between her fingers.
example_zh: 她緊張地在指間撚著麵包。

example_en: The package had been badly crushed in the post.
example_zh: 包裹在郵寄過程中被壓而嚴重受損。

example_en: a crystal vase
example_zh: 水晶玻璃花瓶

example_en: a cunning plan/ploy
example_zh: 詭詐的計劃／花招

example_en: The government should act to curb tax evasion.
example_zh: 政府應該採取行動抑制逃稅。

chinese_meaning: 照管，監護;（尤指對父母離異或去世的孩子的）監護權
example_en: The court awarded/granted/gave custody of the child to the father.
example_zh: 法庭將孩子的監護權判給了父親。

chinese_meaning: 憤世嫉俗的;懷疑人之真誠的;認為人皆自私的
example_en: She has a pretty cynical view of men.
example_zh: 她對男人的態度太過偏激。

example_en: He had workman's hands which were rough and covered with calluses.
example_zh: 他有一雙工人的手，粗糙且布滿老繭。

chinese_meaning: 運動參加者;運動倡導者;活動家
example_en: an animal rights campaigner
example_zh: 動物權益運動的支持者

example_en: The former communist embraced capitalism and started his own company.
example_zh: 這位前共產黨員擁抱了資本主義並創辦了自己的公司。

example_en: Their forces capitulated five hours after the bombardment of the city began.
example_zh: 在該市被轟炸了五個小時之後，他們的軍隊投降了。

example_en: a capricious child
example_zh: 任性的小孩

example_en: Gently he caressed her cheek.
example_zh: 他輕撫她的臉頰。

example_en: We'd been up carousing till the early hours and were exhausted.
example_zh: 我們痛飲狂歡一直到淩晨，個個都筋疲力盡了。

example_en: Health inspectors castigated the kitchen staff for poor standards of cleanliness.
example_zh: 衛生檢查員嚴厲地批評了廚房工作人員清潔工作做得太差。

example_en: chapped lips
example_zh: 皸裂的嘴唇

example_en: My dad's such a cheapskate that he cuts his hair himself.
example_zh: 我爸爸真是個吝嗇鬼，連他的頭髮都自己剪。。

example_en: She goes to her doctor for regular check-ups.
example_zh: 她去醫生那裡接受定期的體檢。

example_en: The investigation revealed political chicanery and corruption at the highest levels.
example_zh: 調查揭露了最高層的政治欺詐和腐敗。

chinese_meaning: （成人）孩子般的，單純的，純真無邪的
example_en: a childlike innocence/quality
example_zh: 孩子般的天真無邪／氣質

example_en: You seem mighty chipper this morning - what's up?
example_zh: 你今天早上看上去開心極了——有甚麼喜事？

example_en: The cake was burned to a cinder (= burned black).
example_zh: 蛋糕烤焦了。

example_en: Officials were circumspect about saying what the talks had achieved.
example_zh: 官員們對談判所取得的成果持謹慎態度。

example_en: The Romans set out to civilize the Ancient Britons.
example_zh: 羅馬人著手教化古不列顛人。

example_en: He suffers from claustrophobia so he never travels on underground trains.
example_zh: 他患有幽閉恐懼症，所以從不乘坐地鐵。

chinese_meaning: （常指堅決或生氣地）捏緊，握緊，咬緊
example_en: The old man clenched his fist and waved it angrily at us.
example_zh: 那老頭緊握著拳頭，氣哼哼地向我們揮舞著。

example_en: It costs a lot to feed and clothe five children.
example_zh: 解決五個孩子的吃穿問題花費很大。

chinese_meaning: （尤指從空中、海上或地圖上看到的）海岸線

example_en: The court heard that the six defendants had been coerced into making a confession.
example_zh: 法庭在審理中發現六名被告曾受到迫供。

example_en: We should be cognizant of the fact that every complaint is not a justified complaint.
example_zh: 我們應該認識到並非每一樁投訴都是合理的。

chinese_meaning: （論據、觀點、計劃）有條理的，連貫的，前後一致的
（詞語或表達方式）口語的，俗語的，非正式的
example_en: colloquial speech
example_zh: 口語

example_en: These days he plays to audiences of a hundred or fewer which is a bit of a comedown after Wembley Stadium.
example_zh: 如今，看他打球的觀眾只有100位甚至更少，跟溫布利球場的情景相比，真是有些落泊。

example_en: She carried on passionate love affairs with the consent of her complaisant husband.
example_zh: 她得到順從的丈夫的同意，繼續著熱烈的婚外情。

chinese_meaning: 良心的不安;內疚;自責;後悔
example_en: I wouldn't have any compunction about telling him to leave.
example_zh: 我不會因為叫他走開而覺得內疚。

example_en: They've just computerized the whole system.
example_zh: 他們剛剛完成了整個系統的電腦化。

example_en: The conceit of that man is incredible!
example_zh: 那人極度自負！

example_en: I condensed ten pages of comments into/to two.
example_zh: 我將十頁的評論壓縮成了兩頁。

example_en: An elderly man from Hull has confounded doctors by recovering after he was officially declared dead.
example_zh: 赫爾市的一位老人在被正式宣佈死亡後居然活了過來，令醫生們大惑不解。

chinese_meaning: 女國會議員;（尤指美國）女衆議院議員
example_en: The incumbent congresswoman is up for re-election.
example_zh: 現任女議員即將競選連任。

chinese_meaning: 內涵意義;隱含意義;聯想意義
example_en: The word "lady" has connotations of refinement and excessive femininity that some women find offensive.
example_zh: lady 一詞有優雅和過分嬌柔的涵義，因此某些女性覺得該詞具有冒犯意。

example_en: Make sure that all equipment is clean and free of contaminants.
example_zh: 要確保所有設備是乾淨、未受污染的。

example_en: Much of the coast has been contaminated by nuclear waste.
example_zh: 大部分海岸已受到核廢料污染。

example_en: a contemptuous manner/laugh
example_zh: 輕蔑的態度／大笑

example_en: Couldn't you contrive a meeting between them? I think they'd really like each other.
example_zh: 你不能為他們安排一次會面嗎？我覺得他們真的互有好感。

example_en: The actor had to play a corpse lying in a morgue.
example_zh: 演員必須扮演停屍間的屍體。

example_en: Recent research seems to corroborate his theory.
example_zh: 最新研究似乎證實了他的理論。

example_en: Steel tends to corrode faster in a salty atmosphere.
example_zh: 在鹽分高的環境裡，鋼往往腐蝕得更快。

chinese_meaning: 市政委員;地方議會議員
example_en: a town/city/county/local councillor
example_zh: 鎮／市／郡／地方政務會議員

chinese_meaning: （名詞）可數的（可以與 a 或 an 連用，也有複數形式）
example_en: An example of a countable noun is "table", and an example of an uncountable noun is "money".
example_zh: 例如 table 是可數名詞，money 是不可數名詞。

example_en: Push it down and twist it counterclockwise.
example_zh: 把它按下去然後向逆時針方向擰動。

chinese_meaning: 覬覦，垂涎（尤指他人之物）；貪求，渴望
example_en: She always coveted power but never quite achieved it.
example_zh: 她一直貪求權力，但從未得逞。

example_en: The door creaked on its hinges.
example_zh: 門打開時鉸鏈處嘎吱作響。

example_en: He looked crestfallen at their decision.
example_zh: 聽了他們的決定他滿臉沮喪。

chinese_meaning: （腿腳受傷的人使用的）T形拐杖
example_en: Martin broke his leg and has been on crutches for the past six weeks.
example_zh: 馬丁腿受了傷，六個星期以來一直拄著拐杖。

example_en: My arguments with the boss got worse and worse, and finally culminated in my resignation.
example_zh: 我和老闆的爭吵日益惡化，直到最終我決定換工作。
